CVE-2026-133004.title: pipewire: pipewire: pipewire-pulse client can overwrite the server-computed access label to bypass audio access restrictions
CVE-2026-133004.description: A flaw was found in PipeWire's PulseAudio compatibility server. A local application connecting to the PipeWire PulseAudio socket could override the access restrictions assigned to it by the server and gain unrestricted access to the audio devices and streams of the user's session, instead of the limited access intended for restricted or sandboxed applications. As a result, a malicious application running in a sandbox, such as a Flatpak application granted access to the PulseAudio socket, could observe or modify audio streams belonging to other applications of the same user.
